profile.headline: Experienced software engineer and leader, with a track record of successful products and happy customers.
profile.summary: I have written performance-critical code and managed a team of engineers. No matter what my role, I strive for impact through thoughtful collaboration and a focus on business and customer needs. I contribute more than just code – I make teams better by facilitating communication and removing obstacles in order to improve execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Silicon architecture of rendering and augmented reality capture IP blocks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhanced quality and performance of AMD’s machine-learning acceleration software stack, including the ONNX Execution Provider and XRT driver for the RyzenAI NPU.

* Wrote product code, tests, and automation in C++, Python, bash, and Windows batch
* Ported a large, multi-repo C++ codebase to the Clang toolchain and used Clang's source-based coverage feature to produce code coverage metrics
* Mentored and directed interns
positions.insights: Skills: Performance Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · C++ · Shell Scripting · Windows Batch Scripting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Silicon Valley, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Architected, developed, and deployed performance monitoring for Meta’s low-level audio engine, from instrumentation to data collection and analysis. CI-driven benchmarking, dashboards and alerting gave the team the confidence to deliver features to a massive user base, without fear of performance regressions.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Performance Tuning · Android · C++ · Analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Delivered optimized Opus firmware which decodes hundreds streams in real-time on  the Xbox Series X. Analyzed and optimized performance to run efficiently on a heterogeneous multi-core architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Audio Codecs · Concurrent Programming · Performance Tuning · C (Programming Language) · Embedded Systems

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
* Led development of Mac and Windows applications, drivers, and system software for the award-winning UAD-2 plugin accelerator and Apollo Audio interfaces, products that propelled the company’s 10x revenue growth. Tracked and planned for strategic and tactical needs of multiple products, and executed with both internal and contract developers.

* Inaugurated UA’s third-party development program, establishing UAD as the premier secure DSP platform. Successfully integrated outsourced development to accelerate first-party software delivery, while maintaining impeccable quality.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed cross-platform applications in C++, including audio plug-ins with VST, AU, and RTAS support. Modernized and improved a large existing code base.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Analyzed and tuned the performance of OpenGL applications and drivers on the Prism visualization supercomputer.
positions.insights: Skills: Unix · OpenGL · Performance Tuning · C++

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Intern at Intel Architecture Labs, working on a 3D authoring environment for the Web.

positions.title: Graphics Engineer
positions.description: Developed major new features in C for the Fractal Design Painter application, enabling creative and efficient workflows. Fixed long-standing bugs and made performance enhancements that improved customer satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Image Processing · Cross-platform Development · C (Programming Language) · Graphical User Interface (GUI) · Debugging

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed firmware in C for a digital video headend system, and a GUI provisioning application in C++ for a fiber telephony switching system.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · C++
